Rigid Rx(+90°). Functional lower power cavities / control block rebuilt to NVE41289 pp.100/120/123. Named encoder, ESC, service cover and CAN Run/Err LEDs; HMI window, legend planes and QR sticker laid out to the photographed ATV320U04M2C fascia. Control connector placement is functional, not certified metrology.

90×70×80 mm (H×W×D) DIN TH35 housing, 4-channel electronic circuit protection. Spring-clamp terminals: 2× +24V inputs 16 mm² top, ON/13/14 signal terminals 2.5 mm² top-center, 4× OUT 4 mm² bottom, 2× GND 4 mm² bottom corners. Per-channel: countersunk 1/2/4/6 A current selector, bi-colour LED (green/red, flash states), ON/OFF button. Group alarm potential-free 13-14, remote ON, cascading 75 ms channel start, status memory. Front serigraphy MURR ELEKTRONIK + LED legend. Dimensioned reconstruction, not manufacturer STEP.

Six finite top/bottom conductor inlet slots aligned with the front wells, each with a visible copper clamp inside; recessed captive Pozidriv screws near the deck faces; divider walls between poles on both decks; red DIN release tab at the bottom front; function/timing diagram serigraphy on both flanks (photos IMG_5849-5851). Exact terminal identities A1/S/A2/15/16/18 retained. Manual fascia has separate knobs / LEDs; B1 reference retyped where applicable. Dimensioned visualization, not manufacturer STEP or certified metrology.
